label: Hasankeyf, Turkey: old town flooded by the Ilısu reservoir

verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Surface water index (NDWI) rose by 0.47 relative to the control trajectory in the 6 months after 5 Jan 2020 (90% interval −0.56 to +1.49). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 4 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.08). Counted by gap size instead, 2 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.05). The interval is too wide to rule a meaningful change in or out.
reasons: the interval is too wide to rule a meaningful change in or out

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar shows a change beyond what the controls did.
